engine_differences.alea: Fixed identity geometry and fixed-discard warmup; analytic scores; ChaCha12 logical streams; serialization excluded from retained time
engine_differences.blackjax: Fixed identity geometry and fixed-discard warmup; JAX float64 AD; synchronized JIT scans and distinct RNG; compilation separated
engine_differences.nuts-rs: Native gradient-initialized diagonal geometry and native diagonal warmup; fixed step with jitter disabled; distinct RNG; not a matched-geometry efficiency claim; shared analytic Rust formulas, algebraic fixed-shape Wiener drift density; expanded statistics/position allocation included in retained time
engine_differences.stan: Fixed unit_e geometry, no adaptation or jitter; native reverse AD and distinct RNG; native CSV-inclusive phase times

excluded_claims: No new sampler/default or S3/S4 promotion
Fixed-discard identity policy is not tuned adaptive performance
One physical host does not establish cross-host speed
Finite SBC is a regression gate, not universal calibration
Wiener infers drift only; DDM prediction covers boundary events
Unavailable upstream allocation/gradient counters are null with reasons
Stan native phase timings include CSV output; process-wall efficiency is the common timing scope

promotion.maturity_scope: S2 experiment utility only; no automatic sampler or release promotion

open_map_laws.claim: Sampled signed-reversal regressions exist, but the production transition performs no per-proposal involution check.
The current energy-only Metropolis correction is valid only if the open support, reversibility, and volume assumptions hold.
A bounded forward implicit solve does not establish that the reverse solve selects the same numerical branch.
Low-dimensional numerical Jacobian evidence does not close the finite-tolerance map assumption on adversarial metrics.
